mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( pet_name, owner_name, animal_type, doctor_name, reservation_date, status, price ) VALUES ( #{petName}, #{ownerName}, #{animalType}, #{doctorName}, #{reservationDate}, #{status}, #{price} )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET pet_name = #{petName}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, animal_type = #{animalType}, doctor_name = #{doctorName}, reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, status = #{status}, price = #{price} WHERE id = #{id}
